agent.name: Creative AI Digital Twin Lite
agent.description: A generic digital-twin agent for creators. Builds alignment through prediction games, generates rigged 3D avatars via Tripo3D with C2PA provenance, registers on-chain coherence to Base via ERC-8004, and acts as a real-time studio assistant and live-chat moderator for YouTube and Twitch streams with Twitch-native clip creation. Can also create, edit, and render video via the Creative Pixels MCP when connected.
agent.vibe: reflective, curious, creator-first, earns trust before acting

secrets.name: TRIPO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Tripo3D API key for text-to-3D avatar generation. Get one at https://platform.tripo3d.ai. Without it, the generate-avatar skill is disabled.

secrets.name: PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: 0x-prefixed Ethereum private key for the agent's dedicated wallet. Used by @Pinata/ERC8004 for on-chain alignment registration. Create a NEW wallet — never use your personal wallet — and fund it with only the minimum ETH needed for gas on Base.

secrets.name: PINATA_JWT
secrets.description: Pinata API JWT token. Used by attached Pinata skills. Get one at app.pinata.cloud → Developers → API Keys → New Key (Admin permissions).

secrets.name: PINATA_GATEWAY_URL
secrets.description: Pinata dedicated gateway domain (e.g. your-gateway.mypinata.cloud). Find it at app.pinata.cloud → Gateways.

secrets.name: AUDIO_LLM_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the audio-capable LLM used by the studio assistant (process-live-audio skill). Works with OpenAI GPT-4o or Google Gemini depending on AUDIO_LLM_PROVIDER.

secrets.name: AUDIO_LLM_PROVIDER
secrets.description: Provider for audio analysis. Set to 'openai' (default) or 'google'. Paired with AUDIO_LLM_API_KEY.

secrets.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
secrets.description: YouTube Data API v3 key. Required for YouTube live chat monitoring via the monitor-youtube-chat skill.

secrets.name: YOUTUBE_VIDEO_ID
secrets.description: Optional default YouTube video id used for HEARTBEAT (autonomous) chat monitoring. Can be overridden per-invocation in chat.

secrets.name: TWITCH_CHANNEL
secrets.description: Optional default Twitch channel name used for HEARTBEAT (autonomous) chat monitoring. Anonymous read-only monitoring requires no token.

secrets.name: TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Twitch application client id. Required (paired with TWITCH_OAUTH_USER_TOKEN) for the create-twitch-clip skill.

secrets.name: TWITCH_OAUTH_USER_TOKEN
secrets.description: Twitch user OAuth token with the 'clips:edit' scope. Required (paired with TWITCH_CLIENT_ID) for clip creation — Twitch does not support anonymous clipping.

secrets.name: PIXELS_WORKSPACE
secrets.description: Absolute path to a local Creative Pixels workspace directory used by the Creative Pixels MCP server (`npm run headless:mcp -- --workspace <dir>`). Must be local and non-cloud-synced. Optional until you want conversational video edit/render.
